title.narrative: Increased capacity of the constituents to build a strong and resilient social and solidarity economy for decent work

description.narrative: Increasing the capacity of governments and employers' and workers' organizations to promote a strong and resilient social and solidarity economy (SSE) is key to advancing decent work and inclusive, sustainable development. The ILO supports constituents by strengthening the evidence base and providing policy guidance and services to develop, adopt, revise and operationalize policy measures targeting SSE entities, in line with the Resolution concerning decent work and the SSE (2022). It is grounded in fundamental principles and rights at work and international labour standards, including the Promotion of Cooperatives Recommendation, 2002 (No. 193), and in social dialogue. The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area: (1) Research, statistics and knowledge products to strengthen the evidence base for policy measures targeting SSE entities, including the development and use of international statistical standards (2) A global policy toolkit to support constituents in developing, adopting, revising and operationalizing such measures, and strengthening monitoring, evaluation and learning (3) Services to strengthen policy coherence, coordination and partnerships for such measures at global, regional and office-wide levels, including through development cooperation.
